As any dieter knows, one of the biggest problems with achieving a lean look is pockets of diet resistant fat that are impervious to calorie restriction and exercise. Let’s say, that you are dieting, exercising, and taking an excellent OTC diet pill like Phenyltropic X, or one of the Pharmaceutical diet drugs I wrote about several weeks ago. You may be doing everything right, but still be unable to get rid of your diet resistant fat pockets. Sure, you could go on a starvation diet, and these diet resistant fat pockets would eventually go away. However, in the process, you would cannibalize all the muscle that you worked so hard to put on.

Diet resistant fat is a problem for both men and women. For men it is often the love handles that take away from hard earned abs or the soft fat that mars the well-built chest. In women it is the thighs and hips that seem to never thin out or the back arm fat that jiggles. These diet resistant fat pockets are often the difference between looking just OK and looking great, whether it’s strolling on the beach, out on the town in a tight shirt, or showing a little thigh in a new dress.

Here’s what happens when you diet and take a good thermogenic diet pill like Phenyltropic X or a pharmaceutical diet drug.

Initially, you burn a lot of fat because of the thermogenic properties of the diet pill. Thermogenesis is a fancy way of saying raised body temperature. Thermogenesis is a good thing for the dieter, because it promotes fat loss. Unfortunately, it is hard to achieve a prolonged state of thermogenesis and this explains why fat loss that was significant at first decreases over time.

Try taking your body\'s temperature first thing upon waking in the morning. While dieting, if your waking temperature is between 97.8 and 98.2 degrees Fahrenheit, you are in a fat burning mode. A few individuals with optimal metabolism will have a body temperature of higher than 98.2, but eventually all dieters will get below the optimal range and will find that fat burning becomes much more difficult. On almost any diet, body temperature decreases over time.

Here\'s a summary of what is actually happening when you diet with a good diet pill.

  1. Initially, the B2 and B3 receptors are stimulated causing an increased production of adrenaline and noradrenaline.
  2. This increased production raises the body\'s temperature.
  3. Lots of fat is lost in the cells that are high in B1 receptors.
  4. However, very little fat is lost in the cells that have many A2 receptors. The A2 receptors are concentrated in the abs and love handles in men and on the hips and thighs in women.
  5. As dieting continues, noradrenaline levels drop and the body\'s temperature begins to fall along with it.
  6. As temperature drops over time, fat loss slows.
  7. In the remaining fat cells, the number of A2 receptors increases, compared to B2 and B3 receptors, and the body will chose to burn amino acids from muscle tissue for fuel instead of fat.

So, this A2 receptor is the bad guy and the best way to prevent the slow down in fat loss would be to block the A2 receptors from accepting noradrenaline.
In the past, I’ve written about using Yohimbine HCl to take the breaks off this ugly A2 receptor that causes women a hard time losing fat -- especially in their lower body - no matter how hard they diet. And in men, the concentration of this receptor in the abdominal region and around the love handles gives guys a hard time burning fat around the waist - no matter how hard they diet.

Traditionally, the problem with yohimbine treatment is that the areas in men and women that need it most tend to have poor blood flow – making it difficult for your body to get it to where it is needed most. Another problem is that when taken orally yohimbine has a short half-life so it must be take frequently to maintain decent blood levels.

Here are three ways to use Yohimbine HCl:

  1. Take Yohimbine HCl powder topically if fat loss is your most important goal.
  2. Oral admin is more stimulatory- a small dose sublingually about 10-15min prior to workout can be very beneficial- much lower doses than topical.
  3. Out partying or want to get really wired. Yohimbine HCl can be snorted -- though don\'t over do it, -- it will make you feel crappy.

My friend, the late Dan Duchaine, was the first to explore the topical application of Yohimbine. He initially tried subcutaneous injections but the effects were limited and shots were quite painful. Then he created a topical formulation that worked, but still had poor delivery, and worse yet, it smelled, and turned the treated area brown.
So, what is the best way to topically administer Yohimbine?

First off, dosing will vary depending on tolerance. A 20mg dose is a good place to start though some can tolerate/enjoy much higher doses - you will know when you take too much as it will not feel good. (Headache, tired, just unwell - nothing really bad just annoying)

Second, it’s important to select the right carrier for maximal absorption.
One good one is aloe vera, while aloe vera gel is effective, the use of pure liquid aloe vera is recommended. This carrier also hydrates the skin.

Menthol is another good carrier. Aspercreme (1%menthol) or Bengay (16%menthol) are both menthol carriers. And, the salicylic acid (aspirin) in these formulations may further enhance penetration. Oil based menthol carriers include peppermint (50% l-menthol), wintergreen (50-70%) and spearmint oils (50-70%)- all of which are excellent carriers and penetration enhancers. I prefer Japanese peppermint oil, as I like the way it smells. When using menthol oils, be sure to dilute about 8 parts water or better, aloe vera, to 1 part oil.

Capsicum, the active agent in hot red chili peppers, works well too. Capsicum can be found in several cream products. You want the more capsicum the better. But it may be too harsh for some people, so perhaps it is best diluted and added to other carriers.
Pluronic gel, a.k.a. phlogel- should only be used in areas with poor blood flow- as it will dramatically increase uptake. This is difficult to obtain and probably not worth the effort as similar results can be obtained cheaper and more easily.

Two carriers that I would avoid are gelled alcohol and isopropyl myristate- a widely available, cheap, cosmetic ingredient. Both are better suited to topical delivery of steroids. Of course, you can and should use topical alcohol to clean the site prior to administration.

The last carrier, DMSO, works well but may speed yohimbine too quickly into blood stream and makes your breath stink of garlic. It may be an option for those who want to take a low dose of Yohimbine. A high dose with DMSO is unwise. To further enhance the effect of the Yohimbine, you can add crushed T3 tabs or triac. Please note, this is illegal- actually the use of DMSO as a carrier is illegal, so this is for informational purposes only. Personally, I think that topical use of Yohimbine with oil based carriers and oral t3 use are more effective- but it is worth mentioning as some have gotten good results with this combo.

The best thing to do is to try these different carriers to find the ones that are right for you. The easiest to get are menthol (Aspercreme, Bengay, peppermint oil-diluted) and aloe. Swab the area with alcohol just prior to application, and most people I have worked with get good results. If you have large pockets of fat with little blood flow (you can tell because these areas are always cold) then using stronger penetration enhancers is advisable. Women, because they have thinner skin, will probably need to use less penetration enhancers.

TIPS AND TRICKS- CARRIERS AND PENETRATION ENHANCERS
1. Apply after a hot shower
2. Use a body scrub to get rid of dead skin- this should be done 2-3 times a week
3. It may be of some benefit to swab the area with diluted alcohol prior to admin- though this is probably only really beneficial if not applying after a shower.
4. Use one or more carriers- depending on the site of application.

If all this is too technical, or just sounds like a lot of work, then I think you should investigate MP Technologies’ Yohimburn, which is what I personally use. MP Technologies has taken the idea of topical delivery and made it a reality with Yohimburn. Yohimburn uses an advanced but very safe topical delivery system that insures significant delivery of yohimbine to a localized area. What this means is that it delivers yohimbine to where you need it most. Additionally, because of its delivery method Yohimburn is inherently time released with good fat burning effects throughout the day with only a single application. Best of all, it tingles, has a nice peppermint smell, and it did not turn my skin brown like the first generation Yohimbine topicals. Stacked with Phenyltropic X, it’s an unbeatable combo. The recently discovered hormone ghrelin may be the key to explaining why we get hungry, why dieters lose weight and gain it back, and why severely obese people can lose a great deal of weight from stomach surgery. For the dieting or bulking bodybuilder, the discovery of ghrelin may be revolutionary in its ability to enable us to manipulate hunger.

Ghrelin is secreted by the stomach and small intestine and it stimulates appetite. Ghrelin is thought to be nature\'s way of making people fatten up when food is plentiful in order to increase survival during cycles of famine. This protective mechanism is now harmful when plenty of high-calorie food is available. It is the first natural appetite stimulant that scientists have found that is secreted outside the brain. Ghrelin communicates with the brain and the digestive system and helps the body regulate eating.

Before we eat, our levels of ghrelin peak. The levels drop after a meal. When given a ghrelin injection, people think that they are starving. In fact, in studies of the effects of ghrelin injections, people who were allowed to eat as much as they wanted, were on average shown to consume 30% more calories than when they did not have the ghrelin injection before eating. Additionally, ghrelin decreases metabolism and makes it harder for the body to burn fat.

One of the paradoxes of dieting is that after we diet, our bodies produce more ghrelin than before we dieted. This may partially explain why dieters often rebound after a diet and gain back the lost weight and more.

In contrast with the dieter, the very obese that have undergone weight reduction surgery known as "gastric bypass" produce little ghrelin. This may explain why the surgery is so effective. With little ghrelin produced, the obese eat much less.

A study reported in the New England Journal of Medicine, involved two groups of patients who had sharply reduced their weight and kept stable for three months. The first of the two groups contained five patients who had undergone gastric bypass surgery the second group contained thirteen patients who had undergone a supervised low-fat liquid diet. Ghrelin levels were studied in both groups.

Five patients who had gastric bypass surgery dropped from an average of 435 pounds to 280 pounds, while 13 people on the supervised low fat, liquid diet dropped from an average weight of 220 pounds to 182 pounds.

In the diet group, ghrelin levels were consistently about 50 percent higher after weight loss. Levels spiked before meals and plunged after, both before and after weight loss.

The bypass group had barely detectable ghrelin levels and on average had 72 percent less ghrelin than five dieters who ended up at about the same body mass index, a ratio of weight to height. The bypass patients also had 77 percent less ghrelin on average than a comparison group of 10 normal-weight people.

For the bodybuilder, the discovery of ghrelin could be profound. Since it is produced outside of the brain, it may be easier for scientists and researchers to make drugs to either stimulate ghrelin production or to inhibit it. If ghrelin production could be decreased or its action blocked, dieting could become a cakewalk. Likewise, if drugs could increase the production of ghrelin, the appetite stimulation could make bulking much easier.

Phoenix Pharmaceuticals sells ghrelin for research purposes.

Flax oil is the most important food you can consume to strip off every last ounce of bodyfat, and in a stack with Phenyltropic X and Triple Threat 3/60, you can use it to strip off all of your body fat too! That is quite a statement to make, but it\'s 100% accurate - let me explain why. Some of you may know that there are two essential fatty acids that are necessary for us to maintain optimal health, and also for use to stay alive. They are the Omega-3 fatty acids and the Omega-6 fatty acids. The one that we are primarily concerned about for metabolism is the Omega-3 fatty acids. And the richest source of Omega-3 fatty acids is Flax Oil.

Omega-3 fatty acid is important because it enables the body to make prostaglandins. Prostaglandins are a group of hormone like substances that mediate a wide range of physiological functions, such as metabolism, smooth muscle activity, and nerve transmission. And as I mentioned before, they are important because they are derived from unsaturated fat.

The dieter\'s dilemma is that the Omega-3 fatty acids are hard to come by from food alone. You see, most dietary fat that we consume is highly processed saturated fat. And this type of fat does not contain many Omega 3 fatty acids. If it did, the general American population would not be as overweight as it is! Instead, saturated fats contain trans fatty acids, which cause high cholesterol and do not have any beneficial effects on the metabolism.

In contrast, High Lignan Flax Oil, does not contain trans fatty acids and as mentioned before is the richest source of the Omega 3 fatty acids. The dietitians, doctors, and old-school bodybuilders who claim that all fat is bad and that all fat makes you fat are just plain wrong! Most Americans are deficient in the Omega-3 fatty acids because it is almost impossible to get them from diet alone without supplementation. And since the Prostaglandins that mediate metabolism and muscle activity are derived from Omega-3 fatty acid, it is crucial to have enough of it around for the body to burn fat.

This is not speculation, but researched fact. A diet higher in Omega-3 fatty acids of which High Lignan Flax Oil is the richest source, will have more lean muscle, lower bodyfat, and better health. In fact, the Omega-3\'s are so important, that they have been found to be all of the following:

  • Cholesterol reducing (the perfect fat to include on a Ketogenic or Atkins diet)
  • Anti-lipogenic (they block fat storage)
  • Anti-catabolic (they prevent muscle breakdown)
  • Increase lipolysis and beta oxidation (Fat burning -- even the brown fat cells in the love handles)
  • Improve insulin sensitivity (Keeping blood sugar levels down and metabolism high)
  • Increase thermogenesis (Slightly elevated body temperature promotes faster fat burning)

Adding flaxseed oil to your foods, or taken with a meal, creates a feeling of satiation (feeling of fullness and satisfaction following a meal). The essential fats in flaxseed oil cause the stomach to retain food for a longer period of time as compared to no-fat or low-fat foods. The addition of Flax Oil to food results in a gradual release of nutritients into the small intestine. The physiological effect is a slow, sustained rise in blood sugar, then a prolonged plateau of blood sugar. Ultimately, the blood sugar undergoes a slow and gradual drop.

You will experience a corresponding feeling of prolonged energy, stamina and satisfaction with no immediate hunger pangs following the meal. The net result is that you feel fuller, longer and, actually eat fewer calories in the long run than if you would have chosen a no-fat or low-fat diet.

Meet poor Billy. Billy stands over 6 feet tall and weighs around 270 pounds. Billy was born a healthy, normal man - good looking, good genetics, naturally strong. But now, when he\'s not working the talk show circuit, Billy has an exciting career as an exotic dancer. Some guys just love watching poor Billy shake and shimmy his double D\'s. How did Billy grow breasts like the guy in Fight Club with the huge knockers? Our friend Billy used anabolic steroids without anti-estrogens.

To understand what happened to poor Billy, in this issue of Elite Fitness News, we\'ll examine estrogen and its relationship to male use of anabolic steroids. Brought to you by elitefitness.com and my friend Grendel from Anabolic Extreme, this groundbreaking article, "Why Billy has Breasts!" is an excerpt from Grendel\'s new book Anabolica, which I\'ll be telling you more about in the next few weeks.

Also in this week\'s EFN, we\'ll look at drugs you can use to annihilate estrogen in a blinding burst of anabolic goodness! Read on, unless of course you actually want a career in the exotic dancing arts like our friend Billy.

Why Billy Has Breasts: The Story of Estrogen

Before we begin to talk about all the great benefits of anabolic steroids I think it is important to take a moment to talk about side effects and how to prevent them. The biggest source of steroid related side effects comes from the impact anabolic steroids have on your body\'s production of estrogen. So, here is a quick biochemical over-view of estrogen.
Estrogens regulate the growth, differentiation, and functioning of diverse target tissues, both within and outside of the reproductive system. Most of the actions of estrogens appear to be exerted via the estrogen receptor (ER) of target cells, an intracellular receptor that is a member of a large super family of proteins that function as ligand-activated transcription factors, regulating the synthesis of specific RNAs and proteins. This process is almost identical to the action by which anabolic steroids affect protein synthesis.

Estrogen is also a steroid hormone, although not used for athletic enhancement. However, estrogen plays a key role in the use of AAS. Certain steroids, at high enough dosages, can convert via the enzyme aromatase into other hormones; in the case of testosterone-based steroids this other hormone is usually estrogen. Steroids with a dihydrotestosterone (DHT) base are not subject to aromatization; as a metabolite of testosterone its structure is not affected by the aromatase. Steroids with 17-alkylated structures generally convert into weaker estrogens. Some steroids, such as nandrolone (deca-durabolin) or trenbolone (parabolan, or in most people\'s cases Finaplex) convert into progesterone.

High dosages of steroids for prolonged periods also shut down the body\'s natural production of certain hormones (particularly testosterone) when steroid therapy is stopped the body attempts to establish homeostasis by adjusting hormonal levels. The average ratio of testosterone to estrogen in a healthy male is 100:1. When drugs increase the testosterone in the body, the body will respond by increasing the estrogen in the body. Additionally, estrogen circulates in the body bound to the protein SHBG (sex hormone binding globulin) as does the testosterone. SHBG is produced in the liver and use of steroids increases the production of this protein; which has a very high receptor affinity for testosterone. With more SHBG in the body, more testosterone is bound, becoming inactive as only free testosterone can activate an androgen receptor. SHBG, however, has poorer receptor affinity for estrogen and more active free estrogen circulates in the body, further altering the hormonal balance. These effects of steroids (i.e. the potential for conversion into estrogen, as well as the disruption of the hormonal balance in the body) can cause serious side effects in male users. Thus, steroid users seek ways to block this estrogen from affecting them.

That is all a very nice and formal way of saying that you need to be taking anti-estrogens when you are using steroids. See, without the anti-estrogens you get all sorts of pleasant side effects, not limited to a nice pair of breasts (with oh -so tender nipples) and extra body fat! Without anti-estrogens you will end up like poor Billy, shaking his titties in the face of wealthy Japanese businessmen. No, seriously, this chapter will explore how to effectively use anti-estrogens to prevent many of the side effects that accompany anabolic steroid usage.

The Drugs Are Your Friends

Oral clomiphene citrate (Clomid) is an ovulation stimulant used to treat ovulatory failure in women. Oral tamoxifen citrate (Nolvadex) belongs to a class of antineoplastics called antiestrogens. It is used to treat breast cancer. Body builders use both of these drugs. Why on earth would they do that?

The answer is that both of these drugs are anti-estrogens. The term anti-estrogen is a little inaccurate. This class of pharmaceutical does not engage in some sort of matter/anti-matter reaction, annihilating estrogen in a blinding burst of anabolic goodness. Rather, let us think of the classical anti-estrogen drugs (such as nolvadex and clomid) as estrogen receptor antagonists (ERA). These ERAs are chemicals that are close enough in structure to estrogen to fit into the estrogen receptor site; however these chemicals do not have the same chemical effect as estrogen. The result is that any estrogen produced by the body or exogenous estrogen cannot find an open receptor site to attach to. The free-floating estrogen then presents far less problems to homeostasis.

There is a lot of conflict over using nolvadex, clomid and other ERAs. The regulation of estrogen-induced cellular effects is a multi-step molecular process. The diversity of estrogen and anti-estrogen effects on cellular functions is also modulated by tissue and gene specificity. This diversity of reaction may be explained by different levels of molecular regulation, including the presence of two distinct estrogen receptor isoforms (ER alpha and ER beta), their binding to activator or co-repressor transcriptional proteins, and their affinity to different DNA binding domains of target genes (estrogen responsive element or API). These mechanisms may account for the specific responses to estrogens or anti-estrogens according to tissue, cell or gene level.

Therefore, in English, a drug like nolvadex, which targets breast tissues, is going to do a better job of preventing gynocomastia than is clomid. However clomid has the benefit of boosting the levels of follicle stimulating hormone, which helps restore the bodies natural testosterone levels and protects against testicular atrophy.

Many people stop using their ERA drugs when they end the cycle. That is a terrible idea. Clomid, as we have already discussed, helps immensely with your recovery processes. But remember, there is almost always an estrogen backlash to having been using testosterone drugs for so long. Therefore, many symptoms of high estrogen levels appear after the cycle. I would continue to use both Clomid and Nolvadex for up to 3 weeks after the last of the drugs have left your body. Remember, if on Friday you take 500 mg of a longer acting drug like Sustanon, then don\'t consider the following few weeks as truly off time. That is why it is important to know how long the drugs are effective in your body and yet another reason to switch to faster acting drugs in the last few weeks of a cycle.

Effective dosages of these two drugs are debated. I would recommend that the two drugs be used together, Nolvadex at 20 mg per day, and clomid at 50 mg per day. If Nolvadex is used by itself, 20-40 mg are sufficient. 50-100 mg of clomid can be used if clomid is the only ERA drug. Clomid should be used for two weeks after the last steroid injection to help return your body to its natural hormonal state. Nolvadex and Clomid are mildly expensive, but very available because they are not scheduled drugs and can be legally imported.
There is a second class of drug used to combat estrogen side effects from what is grandly called steroid therapy; there are aromatase inhibitors. As mentioned previously in this chapter, the body can convert testosterone into estrogen using the enzyme aromatase. This second group of drugs, which I will call the inhibitors, prevents this process from occurring at all. This class of medication is generally only prescribed for severe conditions and is generally more expensive then any of the ERA.

Teslac, (testolactone), has fallen out of favor for several reasons. First of all, almost one gram daily is needed to achieve sufficient estrogen synthesis inhibition. This makes this a very expensive drug to use. Also, it is currently a scheduled drug because it is a testosterone derivate.

Cytadren (aminoglutethimide) is a better choice, requiring dosages of between 250-500 mg per day to suppress estrogen synthesis. 250mg cytadren doesn\'t cause significant desmolase inhibition, so there would still be cortisol and other steroids, while estrogen is minimized! Cytadren is used therapeutically to combat Cushing\'s syndrome because it also interferes with the body\'s ability to synthesis cortisol. Sounds like fun, huh ... no cortisol, no estrogen. What a fantastic environment. Tell that to Andreas Munzer! Cytadren can cause cysts as well as effect things like blood clotting. It is reported that Munzer used 1-2g(!) of cytadren/day! Therefore cytadren use should be done with precision.
Arimidex (anastrozole) is a drug designed to combat second stage breast cancer. It is an extremely potent drug; one pill per day is sufficient to almost entirely inhibit estrogen in the body. However, the draw back is that this one pill per day can cost you around ten dollars.

The final conclusion about inhibitors is that these are far more powerful drugs then the ERA. All the drugs listed above effect a much wider hormonal spread then the anti-estrogens and they are also going to cost you a lot more. Of all the drugs mentioned, I think that arimidex is the most useful drug for the body builder. Duchaine helped promote cytadren, particularly because of its anti-catabolic ability to suppress cortisol. But, even he acknowledged the double-edged sword that this drug was. Too little cortisol is painful to the joints and in the end, extremely dangerous. I would not recommend the use of cytadren, but I have provided the moderate dosage schemes. The bottom line: These are not drugs to pop like M&Ms.

The Argument Against Our Little Friends

But these drugs decrease your gains right? Damn it. I hate hearing that phrase clutched to…you guessed it…peoples\' breast like a mantra. First of all, there is no way of telling what your gains would have been like without nolvadex or clomid. The scientific evidence that gave rise to this whole dispute (which I believe Duchaine had a hand in too) is that in addition to its anti-estrogenic action requiring estrogen receptors (ER) and leading to growth arrest of breast cancers, studies have previously shown that the anti-hormone tamoxifen (nolvadex) is able to block EGF, insulin and IGF-I mitogenic activities in total absence of estrogens. Thus the excessive use of anti-estrogens will actually result in a loss of some of the most anabolic of hormones (insulin and insulin-like growth factor 1). Steroid antagonists can inhibit not only the action of agonist ligands of the receptors they are binding to, but can also modulate the action of growth factors by decreasing their receptor concentrations or altering their functionality.

Translation: Yes, you are probably compromising your anabolic state by using ERA. But does that mean they shouldn\'t be used? No. I have heard statements so ridiculous as "Don\'t use anti-estrogens, they cut into your gains and cost too much. Just get surgery". Lovely, just fucking brilliant. Sure, like surgery isn\'t going to cut into your workouts or your gains.

Anti-Estrogens

Lets consider the top drugs used to combat the estrogen based side effects of anabolic steroids.

Clomid

Taken daily during a cycle as an anti-estrogen, dosages range between 50-100 mg per day if used exclusively. If combined with Nolvadex, 50 mg per day is sufficient. For more information on this drug, see the chapter entitled Some Specific Drugs Considered.

Nolvadex

If used alone then 20-40 mg are needed. Some athletes, because of evidence that it negatively impacts various growth factors in the body, dislike this drug. If combined with clomid, 10-20 mg are sufficient. For more information on this drug, see the chapter entitled Some Specific Drugs Considered.

Proviron

This drug binds to androgen receptors but is also helps prevent excess testosterone from converting into estrogen. I consider this effective when stacked with either clomid or nolvadex. 1 pill will do if combined with either 50 mg of clomid or 20 mg or nolvadex. On its own, I suggest at least 2 pills.

Arimidex

This is a very potent drug that prevents the body from converting testosterone into estrogen. The drawback is that is very expensive. The minimum effective dosage is around between a quarter and a half of a milligram/day. This drug does not need to be combined with any other during the cycle; however I recommend you begin using arimidex two weeks prior to commencing your cycle so that the drug can effectively eliminate the enzyme that permits conversion of testosterone to estrogen. Clomid is still useful in the post cycle period. For more information on this drug, see the chapter entitled Some Specific Drugs Considered.

Remember, anti-estrogens are not scheduled. It is perfectly legal to import them and there are many online resources that do this with accuracy and reliability. Don\'t gamble with this aspect of your health and don\'t start until you have all that you need to cover yourself throughout the whole cycle. There is no excuse for not having plenty of clomid and nolvadex on hand.

So, back to our fiend Billy. If he had only taken a few simple precautions, he would not find himself in the predicament he is in now. What has Billy been up to lately? Well, when last I heard from him, he was working at the Hooters - and not in the kitchen I might add.

[sc:signoff-std]

As our readers know, the FDA\'s recent attacks on all products containing Ephedrine and Phenylpropanolamine forced Mass Quantities to cease selling their Phenyltropic PPA drug based diet and energy supplement. I was eager to develop an herbal formulation for Phenyltropic that was high in Ephedrine alkaloids, but naturally occurring. Initially, I thought about using Ma Huang like other manufacturers do, but as I began studying different herbs used by Ayurveda, or traditional Indian medicine, I realized that there were preferable herbs that could produce an even more powerful formula for promoting energy and muscle sparing fat loss.

Sida Cordifolia

One key ingredient in Phenyltropic X is Sida Cordifolia. I chose it over Ma Huang because like Ma Huang, it is high in Ephedrine alkaloids, but Sida Cordifolia also contains additional fat burning components. Additionally, I have found a source for Sida Cordifolia in a potency that is not to be believed. Here\'s a little background.

Sida Cordifolia has been used in Ayurvedic systems for centuries. Whereas ma huang comes from Chinese medicine, Ayurvedic medicine traces its roots to the Himalayan Mountains of India over five thousand years ago. As legend has it, there was a conference held well over 5000 years ago by the wisest healers in India. These scholars and teachers possessed traditional knowledge about the medicinal plants of India that had been handed down orally by the tribes of the Indian forests since the beginning of history. At this conference, these sages compared and combined their knowledge into one body that they called the Ayurveda, from two Sanskrit words; Ayus, or "life", and Veda, or "knowledge".

Ayurveda has been translated to mean "the knowledge of life" or "the science of life". Perhaps a more appropriate translation would be "the knowledge of life span". The Ayurvedic body of knowledge continued to grow until the Ayurvedic physician, Charaka, wrote it down in the first century A.D. By that time, hundreds of years before the birth of European medicine, Ayurveda had specialists in psychiatry, pediatrics, gynecology, ear nose and throat, ophthalmology, surgery, toxicology, virility, and fertility.

Sida Cordifolia is a fast-growing perennial shrub from the steamier parts of tropical and sub-tropical India and Nepal. Its large, leaves are a potent natural source of stimulating ephedrine alkaloids. In Ayurvedic medicine it is valued for its diaphoretic, diuretic and demuculent properties, and also as an aphrodisiac. The stem of the plant contains a number of active compounds, including small amounts of an essential oil, and most important, ephedrine alkaloids, primarily ephedrine, but also pseudoephedrine too. Furthermore, Sida Cordifolia contains other bronchodilating compounds, which Ma-Huang does not contain, in particular vasicinone, vasicine, and vasicinol and, it has been shown to help regulate blood sugar.

Sida Cordifolia helps to stimulate metabolic processes that activate brown fat. Brown fat produces heat by burning large amounts of calories, but often becomes less efficient as we age. Athletes and dieters have reported diminished appetite, increased energy levels, improved physical performance and gains in lean muscle mass. Sida Cordifolia is converted to ephedrine in the liver. The conversion is not immediate, but is instead drawn out over a period of time. This sustained conversion makes for a stimulating effect that can be considered "time released" in which the thermogenic process is drawn out over a longer time span. [to the top]

Synephrine

In addition to Sida Cordifolia, I recommend that Mass Quantities use Citrus aurantium in their new Phenyltropic X formulation, because it too is an excellent fat burner. Citrus aurantium contains appreciable quantities of neohesperidin (14%), and five adrenergic amines (synephrine, N-methyltyramine, hordenine, ocdtopamine, and tyramine). Like ephedrine, synephrine is a well-known bronchial dilator and stimulant.

It has been clinically shown that these adrenergic amines stimulate beta-3 receptors with minimal impact on other receptor sites. This increases the metabolic rate without affecting heart rate or blood pressure. The amines release adrenaline and noradrenaline only in the beta-3 receptor sites -- mostly adipose tissue (fat) and the liver.

Stimulation of the beta-3 receptor sites causes lipolysis or the breakdown of (fat). Simultaneously, this stimulation increases the metabolic rate elevating the body\'s temperature (thermogenesis), which burns calories. Synephrine offers all the advantages of a stimulant, without the drawbacks. It functions to burn fat, increase physical performance, and build lean muscle mass. [to the top]

Guarana

In addition to Synephrine and Sida Cordifolia, I recommended that Mass Quantities use caffeine or guarana in their new Phenyltropic X formulation. They went with Guarana since it is identical to caffeine, and I think that this was a wise choice as it combines well with the other herbals in the Phenyltropic X formulation. [to the top]

White Willow Bark

I also recommended that Mass Quantities include aspirin or preferably white willow bark. Willows have been used for centuries for pain relief and reduction of fever. The leaves can be ingested and they contain salicylic acid, which when synthesized becomes acetylsalicylic acid, otherwise known as aspirin. Willow Bark extract is used like Aspirin, treating mild fevers, colds, infections (influenza), acute and chronic rheumatic disorders, headaches, and pain caused by inflammation.

Natural salicylic acid is nearly as potent as aspirin; however, the compound salicin from willow does not cause gastric or intestinal upset as aspirin can. White willow bark does not block prostaglandins in the stomach or intestines. In its natural form, salicin passes harmlessly through the gastrointestinal tract, becoming saligenin and glucose. The saligenin is then converted to salicylic acid in the blood and the liver. The conversion process takes a few hours, so results will not be felt immediately, but are normally sustained for quite a few hours.

White willow bark was included in Phenyltropic X not only as a potentiator of the ephedrine alkaloids and guarana, but also because it postpones the attenuation of the other herbals making them effective in the body for a longer period of time both after ingestion and over the course of the diet cycle. [to the top]

ECA Research

The active ingredients in Phenyltropic X, ephedrine alkaloids, caffeine, and salicylic acid, have been proven time and time again to help you burn fat faster than possible with dieting and exercising alone. In fact, they melt away body fat without any lifestyle changes at all, so imagine what they can do for an athlete.

One famous study documenting the amazing effects of caffeine and ephedrine on body composition - and there have been many - was conducted by A. Astrup for publication in The International Journal Of Obesity. The compounds were administered to a group of 99 patients over a 50-week period. During the first 25 weeks of the study, the group enjoyed a dramatic reduction of body fat, accompanied by a much better preservation of lean mass than expected. During the second 25 weeks, fat loss continued. Finally, no withdrawal symptoms occurred upon cessation of medication, and no serious side effects were observed.

Another study conducted by Astrup, this time for the prestigious journal Metabolism, illustrated the muscle-sparing effects of caffeine and ephedrine. The double-blind experiment consisted of 14 subjects, each of whom consumed 1000 calories daily. Half the subjects were treated with caffeine and ephedrine, while the other half were treated with a placebo. After 8 weeks, total weight loss was the same - not surprising considering the extreme caloric restriction practiced - but subjects who had received caffeine and ephedrine lost an average of 10 pounds more body fat and 6 pounds less lean mass than the control group.

Phenyltropic does its job in a couple of different (but related) ways. First, with its synergistic dose of caffeine and ephedrine alkaloids, it dramatically increases the production and circulation of the adrenergic hormones.

These hormones, commonly known as adrenaline and noradrenaline, are essential to human survival. Typically released at times of perceived danger, they bind to various receptors (designated as A1, A2, B1, B2, and B3) throughout your nervous and muscle tissue, where they mobilize your natural defense mechanisms.

The most interesting defense mechanisms are controlled by your B2 and B3 receptors. Once "switched on" (or agonized), focus and vigilance are increased while appetite and fatigue are decreased. And lipolysis (release of body fat as fuel along with a sense of satisfaction) is enhanced while lipogenesis (storage of fuel as body fat along with a sense of hunger) is crippled. That means you\'ll be much less likely to cannibalize muscle tissue for energy, even when your body is under extreme stress.

Now this is a little complicated, but read through this and you will realize why it is so important to understand. The B2 and the B3 receptors are responsible for the mobilization and burning of adipose (fat) tissue. These are the receptors that we want to stimulate because these receptors influence fat loss in a positive way. By stimulating these receptors with caffeine and ephedrine alkaloids, we increase the metabolism of fat and we slightly elevate the body\'s temperature. This elevation in the body\'s temperature is called thermogenesis.

Thermogenesis is a fancy way of saying raised body temperature. Thermogenesis is a good thing for the dieter, because it promotes fat loss. Unfortunately, it is hard to achieve a prolonged state of thermogenesis and this explains why fat loss that was significant at first decreases over time.

Try taking your body\'s temperature first thing upon waking in the morning. While dieting, if your waking temperature is between 97.8 and 98.2 degrees Fahrenheit, you are in a fat burning mode. A few individuals with optimal metabolism will have a body temperature of higher than 98.2, but eventually all dieters will get below the optimal range and will find that fat burning becomes much more difficult. On almost any diet, body temperature decreases over time.

With the combination of Sida Cordifolia, Synephrine, guarana, and white willow bark taking care of metabolic stimulation and elevating body temperature, I also wanted to add an ingredient that could stimulate the thyroid and promote thermogenesis. The ingredient I turned to is Commiphora Mukul, which is also known as Guggulsterone. [to the top]

Guggulsterone

Guggulsterone is a ketosteroid that comes from the oleoresin resin of the Guggul tree found in India. Like the other herbs used in Phenyltropic X, Guggulsterone has been used in Ayurveda for centuries. The Guggul tree\'s resin is processed and standardized in laboratories into the plant sterols Z and E Guggulsterones which are highly bioavailable in humans. These sterols exert their influence on many biological processes including thyroid metabolism, cholesterol management, and the dermis (skin).

Studies have demonstrated that ingestion of guggulsterones both in rats and in humans reduces blood lipid levels. One such study involved twenty subjects, recruited through hospital referrals, physician\'s offices and from the surrounding communities of New York City and Greenwich, Connecticut. The study was double-blinded, randomized, and placebo-controlled. Subjects were excluded if they were following a reduced-calorie diet, were taking anorectic medications such as phentermine hydrochloride, sibutramine hydrochloride, or had a history of thyroid disease. Subjects who had never exercised routinely before were also excluded.

The subjects were randomly assigned to one of three groups. The treated group received 750 mg of guggulsterones, the placebo group received maltodextrin (sugar) capsules, and the control group received no treatment for 6 weeks. Subjects followed the American Heart Association Step One diet and exercised three times a week for 45 minutes doing both cardio and weight lifting under the supervision of an exercise physiologist at about 60% of age-predicted maximum heart rate.

Each subject was assessed at baseline and again at Week 6. Subjects were instructed to refrain from ingestion of alcohol during the study and caffeine the day prior to body composition analysis.

The average body weight and average body fat decreased significantly in the treated group (3.2%) for bodyweight and (20.6%) for fat mass. Fat mass decreased significantly in the untreated group as well (8.6%), due to the diet and exercise, although less than in the treated group. The conclusion is that ingestion of guggulsterones concurrent with regular exercise can result in a significant loss of body weight (primarily due to loss of body fat.

The guggulsterones in Mass Quantities Phenyltropic X are a potent dark brown and when ingested work to keep the Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) elevated. The elevation comes from stimulation of the thyroid gland, resulting in increased thyroid hormone production, specifically thyroxin.

Guggulsterones are excellent at burning fat by themselves, but they are amazing when combined with an ECA formulation like sida cordifolia, synephrine, guarana, and white willow bark. Interestingly, the ECA stack and ketogenic diets are great for fat loss, but over time, they can reduce the body\'s ability to convert the thyroid hormone T4 to the more potent T3. Guggulsterones keep this conversion inefficiency from happening.

Two other beneficial properties of Guggulsterone unrelated to fat loss, is its ability to treat acne and lower cholesterol. Several studies have shown Guggulsterones to be slightly more effective than tetracycline for clearing up blemishes. And guggulsterones supports low levels of LDL ("bad") cholesterol and high levels of HDL ("good") cholesterol. [to the top]

L-carnitine

The final ingredient in Phenyltropic X is L-Carnitine. L-carnitine is a nitrogen-containing, short-chain carboxylic acid -- technically, it is not an amino acid, rather, it is a water-soluble, vitamin-like compound. The body produces it from amino acids lysine and methionine. Although carnitine is not an essential nutrient because it can be synthesized in the body, it is sometimes considered conditionally essential in that a dietary deficiency may cause adverse side effects in certain circumstances.
L-carnitine is responsible for transport of long-chain fatty acids across the inner mitochondrial membrane where the fat can then be oxidized or burned. If your body is lacking L-Carnitine (which you can also obtain from animal meat and milk, but not in therapeutic quantities) the fat circulating through your blood cannot efficiently be converted to energy. Instead it is deposited. It is believed that supplemental L-carnitine can promote more efficient fat oxidation resulting in increased fat loss. [to the top]

Author: George Spellwin

Filed Under: Uncategorized

EliteFitness.com – Underground Bodybuilding, Fitness and Steroid Site – Tons of Bodybuilding, Weight Lifting, and Anabolic Steroids

May 9, 2014 by George Spellwin

As our readers know, the FDA\'s recent attacks on all products containing Ephedrine and Phenylpropanolamine forced Mass Quantities to cease selling their Phenyltropic PPA drug based diet and energy supplement. I was eager to develop an herbal formulation for Phenyltropic that was high in Ephedrine alkaloids, but naturally occurring. Initially, I thought about using Ma Huang like other manufacturers do, but as I began studying different herbs used by Ayurveda, or traditional Indian medicine, I realized that there were preferable herbs that could produce an even more powerful formula for promoting energy and muscle sparing fat loss.

Table of contents:

  1. Sida Cordifolia
  2. Synephrine
  3. Guarana
  4. White Willow
  5. ECA Research
  6. Guggulstrerone
  7. L-Carnitine
  8. Summary
  9. Special Offer

The newest formulation for Phenyltropic is called Phenyltropic X. And in it, I have combined a proprietary blend of Ayurvedic herbs: Sida Cordifolia, Synephrine, Guarana, and White Willow Bark and Commiphora Mukul. I also added L-Carnitine for good measure. When you take Phenyltropic X, I think you will find it to be the most powerfully stimulating diet formulation available today. And I guarantee that it will help you to you lose weight and give you unbelievable amounts of new energy - while sparing muscle mass. Here\'s how I developed the new formulation.

Sida Cordifolia

One key ingredient in Phenyltropic X is Sida Cordifolia. I chose it over Ma Huang because like Ma Huang, it is high in Ephedrine alkaloids, but Sida Cordifolia also contains additional fat burning components. Additionally, I have found a source for Sida Cordifolia in a potency that is not to be believed. Here\'s a little background.

Sida Cordifolia has been used in Ayurvedic systems for centuries. Whereas ma huang comes from Chinese medicine, Ayurvedic medicine traces its roots to the Himalayan Mountains of India over five thousand years ago. As legend has it, there was a conference held well over 5000 years ago by the wisest healers in India. These scholars and teachers possessed traditional knowledge about the medicinal plants of India that had been handed down orally by the tribes of the Indian forests since the beginning of history. At this conference, these sages compared and combined their knowledge into one body that they called the Ayurveda, from two Sanskrit words; Ayus, or "life", and Veda, or "knowledge".

Ayurveda has been translated to mean "the knowledge of life" or "the science of life". Perhaps a more appropriate translation would be "the knowledge of life span". The Ayurvedic body of knowledge continued to grow until the Ayurvedic physician, Charaka, wrote it down in the first century A.D. By that time, hundreds of years before the birth of European medicine, Ayurveda had specialists in psychiatry, pediatrics, gynecology, ear nose and throat, ophthalmology, surgery, toxicology, virility, and fertility.

Sida Cordifolia is a fast-growing perennial shrub from the steamier parts of tropical and sub-tropical India and Nepal. Its large, leaves are a potent natural source of stimulating ephedrine alkaloids. In Ayurvedic medicine it is valued for its diaphoretic, diuretic and demuculent properties, and also as an aphrodisiac. The stem of the plant contains a number of active compounds, including small amounts of an essential oil, and most important, ephedrine alkaloids, primarily ephedrine, but also pseudoephedrine too. Furthermore, Sida Cordifolia contains other bronchodilating compounds, which Ma-Huang does not contain, in particular vasicinone, vasicine, and vasicinol and, it has been shown to help regulate blood sugar.

Sida Cordifolia helps to stimulate metabolic processes that activate brown fat. Brown fat produces heat by burning large amounts of calories, but often becomes less efficient as we age. Athletes and dieters have reported diminished appetite, increased energy levels, improved physical performance and gains in lean muscle mass. Sida Cordifolia is converted to ephedrine in the liver. The conversion is not immediate, but is instead drawn out over a period of time. This sustained conversion makes for a stimulating effect that can be considered "time released" in which the thermogenic process is drawn out over a longer time span. [to the top]

Synephrine

In addition to Sida Cordifolia, I recommend that Mass Quantities use Citrus aurantium in their new Phenyltropic X formulation, because it too is an excellent fat burner. Citrus aurantium contains appreciable quantities of neohesperidin (14%), and five adrenergic amines (synephrine, N-methyltyramine, hordenine, ocdtopamine, and tyramine). Like ephedrine, synephrine is a well-known bronchial dilator and stimulant.

It has been clinically shown that these adrenergic amines stimulate beta-3 receptors with minimal impact on other receptor sites. This increases the metabolic rate without affecting heart rate or blood pressure. The amines release adrenaline and noradrenaline only in the beta-3 receptor sites -- mostly adipose tissue (fat) and the liver.

Stimulation of the beta-3 receptor sites causes lipolysis or the breakdown of (fat). Simultaneously, this stimulation increases the metabolic rate elevating the body\'s temperature (thermogenesis), which burns calories. Synephrine offers all the advantages of a stimulant, without the drawbacks. It functions to burn fat, increase physical performance, and build lean muscle mass. [to the top]

Guarana

In addition to Synephrine and Sida Cordifolia, I recommended that Mass Quantities use caffeine or guarana in their new Phenyltropic X formulation. They went with Guarana since it is identical to caffeine, and I think that this was a wise choice as it combines well with the other herbals in the Phenyltropic X formulation. [to the top]

White Willow Bark

I also recommended that Mass Quantities include aspirin or preferably white willow bark. Willows have been used for centuries for pain relief and reduction of fever. The leaves can be ingested and they contain salicylic acid, which when synthesized becomes acetylsalicylic acid, otherwise known as aspirin. Willow Bark extract is used like Aspirin, treating mild fevers, colds, infections (influenza), acute and chronic rheumatic disorders, headaches, and pain caused by inflammation.

Natural salicylic acid is nearly as potent as aspirin; however, the compound salicin from willow does not cause gastric or intestinal upset as aspirin can. White willow bark does not block prostaglandins in the stomach or intestines. In its natural form, salicin passes harmlessly through the gastrointestinal tract, becoming saligenin and glucose. The saligenin is then converted to salicylic acid in the blood and the liver. The conversion process takes a few hours, so results will not be felt immediately, but are normally sustained for quite a few hours.

White willow bark was included in Phenyltropic X not only as a potentiator of the ephedrine alkaloids and guarana, but also because it postpones the attenuation of the other herbals making them effective in the body for a longer period of time both after ingestion and over the course of the diet cycle. [to the top]

ECA Research

The active ingredients in Phenyltropic X, ephedrine alkaloids, caffeine, and salicylic acid, have been proven time and time again to help you burn fat faster than possible with dieting and exercising alone. In fact, they melt away body fat without any lifestyle changes at all, so imagine what they can do for an athlete.

One famous study documenting the amazing effects of caffeine and ephedrine on body composition - and there have been many - was conducted by A. Astrup for publication in The International Journal Of Obesity. The compounds were administered to a group of 99 patients over a 50-week period. During the first 25 weeks of the study, the group enjoyed a dramatic reduction of body fat, accompanied by a much better preservation of lean mass than expected. During the second 25 weeks, fat loss continued. Finally, no withdrawal symptoms occurred upon cessation of medication, and no serious side effects were observed.

Another study conducted by Astrup, this time for the prestigious journal Metabolism, illustrated the muscle-sparing effects of caffeine and ephedrine. The double-blind experiment consisted of 14 subjects, each of whom consumed 1000 calories daily. Half the subjects were treated with caffeine and ephedrine, while the other half were treated with a placebo. After 8 weeks, total weight loss was the same - not surprising considering the extreme caloric restriction practiced - but subjects who had received caffeine and ephedrine lost an average of 10 pounds more body fat and 6 pounds less lean mass than the control group.

Phenyltropic does its job in a couple of different (but related) ways. First, with its synergistic dose of caffeine and ephedrine alkaloids, it dramatically increases the production and circulation of the adrenergic hormones.

These hormones, commonly known as adrenaline and noradrenaline, are essential to human survival. Typically released at times of perceived danger, they bind to various receptors (designated as A1, A2, B1, B2, and B3) throughout your nervous and muscle tissue, where they mobilize your natural defense mechanisms.

The most interesting defense mechanisms are controlled by your B2 and B3 receptors. Once "switched on" (or agonized), focus and vigilance are increased while appetite and fatigue are decreased. And lipolysis (release of body fat as fuel along with a sense of satisfaction) is enhanced while lipogenesis (storage of fuel as body fat along with a sense of hunger) is crippled. That means you\'ll be much less likely to cannibalize muscle tissue for energy, even when your body is under extreme stress.

Now this is a little complicated, but read through this and you will realize why it is so important to understand. The B2 and the B3 receptors are responsible for the mobilization and burning of adipose (fat) tissue. These are the receptors that we want to stimulate because these receptors influence fat loss in a positive way. By stimulating these receptors with caffeine and ephedrine alkaloids, we increase the metabolism of fat and we slightly elevate the body\'s temperature. This elevation in the body\'s temperature is called thermogenesis.

Thermogenesis is a fancy way of saying raised body temperature. Thermogenesis is a good thing for the dieter, because it promotes fat loss. Unfortunately, it is hard to achieve a prolonged state of thermogenesis and this explains why fat loss that was significant at first decreases over time.

Try taking your body\'s temperature first thing upon waking in the morning. While dieting, if your waking temperature is between 97.8 and 98.2 degrees Fahrenheit, you are in a fat burning mode. A few individuals with optimal metabolism will have a body temperature of higher than 98.2, but eventually all dieters will get below the optimal range and will find that fat burning becomes much more difficult. On almost any diet, body temperature decreases over time.

With the combination of Sida Cordifolia, Synephrine, guarana, and white willow bark taking care of metabolic stimulation and elevating body temperature, I also wanted to add an ingredient that could stimulate the thyroid and promote thermogenesis. The ingredient I turned to is Commiphora Mukul, which is also known as Guggulsterone. [to the top]

Guggulsterone

Guggulsterone is a ketosteroid that comes from the oleoresin resin of the Guggul tree found in India. Like the other herbs used in Phenyltropic X, Guggulsterone has been used in Ayurveda for centuries. The Guggul tree\'s resin is processed and standardized in laboratories into the plant sterols Z and E Guggulsterones which are highly bioavailable in humans. These sterols exert their influence on many biological processes including thyroid metabolism, cholesterol management, and the dermis (skin).

Studies have demonstrated that ingestion of guggulsterones both in rats and in humans reduces blood lipid levels. One such study involved twenty subjects, recruited through hospital referrals, physician\'s offices and from the surrounding communities of New York City and Greenwich, Connecticut. The study was double-blinded, randomized, and placebo-controlled. Subjects were excluded if they were following a reduced-calorie diet, were taking anorectic medications such as phentermine hydrochloride, sibutramine hydrochloride, or had a history of thyroid disease. Subjects who had never exercised routinely before were also excluded.

The subjects were randomly assigned to one of three groups. The treated group received 750 mg of guggulsterones, the placebo group received maltodextrin (sugar) capsules, and the control group received no treatment for 6 weeks. Subjects followed the American Heart Association Step One diet and exercised three times a week for 45 minutes doing both cardio and weight lifting under the supervision of an exercise physiologist at about 60% of age-predicted maximum heart rate.

Each subject was assessed at baseline and again at Week 6. Subjects were instructed to refrain from ingestion of alcohol during the study and caffeine the day prior to body composition analysis.

The average body weight and average body fat decreased significantly in the treated group (3.2%) for bodyweight and (20.6%) for fat mass. Fat mass decreased significantly in the untreated group as well (8.6%), due to the diet and exercise, although less than in the treated group. The conclusion is that ingestion of guggulsterones concurrent with regular exercise can result in a significant loss of body weight (primarily due to loss of body fat.

The guggulsterones in Mass Quantities Phenyltropic X are a potent dark brown and when ingested work to keep the Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) elevated. The elevation comes from stimulation of the thyroid gland, resulting in increased thyroid hormone production, specifically thyroxin.

Guggulsterones are excellent at burning fat by themselves, but they are amazing when combined with an ECA formulation like sida cordifolia, synephrine, guarana, and white willow bark. Interestingly, the ECA stack and ketogenic diets are great for fat loss, but over time, they can reduce the body\'s ability to convert the thyroid hormone T4 to the more potent T3. Guggulsterones keep this conversion inefficiency from happening.

Two other beneficial properties of Guggulsterone unrelated to fat loss, is its ability to treat acne and lower cholesterol. Several studies have shown Guggulsterones to be slightly more effective than tetracycline for clearing up blemishes. And guggulsterones supports low levels of LDL ("bad") cholesterol and high levels of HDL ("good") cholesterol. [to the top]

L-carnitine

The final ingredient in Phenyltropic X is L-Carnitine. L-carnitine is a nitrogen-containing, short-chain carboxylic acid -- technically, it is not an amino acid, rather, it is a water-soluble, vitamin-like compound. The body produces it from amino acids lysine and methionine. Although carnitine is not an essential nutrient because it can be synthesized in the body, it is sometimes considered conditionally essential in that a dietary deficiency may cause adverse side effects in certain circumstances.
L-carnitine is responsible for transport of long-chain fatty acids across the inner mitochondrial membrane where the fat can then be oxidized or burned. If your body is lacking L-Carnitine (which you can also obtain from animal meat and milk, but not in therapeutic quantities) the fat circulating through your blood cannot efficiently be converted to energy. Instead it is deposited. It is believed that supplemental L-carnitine can promote more efficient fat oxidation resulting in increased fat loss. [to the top]

So in summary, here\'s what Phenyltropic X does for the dieter and the athlete.

1. YOU\'LL SUPPRESS YOUR APPETITE!

Not only does Phenyltropic X activate fat-burning and muscle-preserving mechanisms in your body, but it also helps suppress your appetite. Keep in mind that all diets still expose you to cravings. Many ketogenic diets, for example, permit you to eat all the fat and protein you want … but no carbs. What if you start to feel an insatiable need for bread, pasta, pizza? IC351 and Vardenafil

IC351 and Vardenafil are PDE5 inhibitors being developed by Eli Lilly and Bayer respectively specifically to treat erectile dysfunction. Losartan is an antihypertensive medication, sold in Germany as Lorzaar, in India as Losacar, and in Israel as Ocsaar and has demonstrated as a side effect dramatic improvements in treating impotency.

IC351 will soon be sold in the States under the brand name Cailis. Initial research indicates that Cailis may be effective at promoting erections for up to 24 hours. That\'s 20 hours longer than Viagra. The benefits to men with erectile dysfunction are obvious, a drug like this would allow men to engage in much more spontaneous sex than would be possible with Viagra.

Where Viagra begins working after 30 minutes and is in full effect after an hour, Cailis begins working in only 16 minutes. In a double-blind study of 61 men with mild to severe erectile dysfunction, the men taking Cailis were more successful at achieving erections even up to 24 hours later. The men were divided into the treatment group who received Cailis and the control group who received a placebo. Neither doctors nor patients knew who received the drug or the placebo. The men were tested at different intervals for a 24 hour period. They were shown sexual images, and erectile response was measured with a device called a Rigiscan. The treated group was much more likely to be able to achieve potent erections than the non-treated group.

A second study was conducted on 223 men, each of whom took either the drug or a placebo, in the privacy of their own home. The men were instructed to take the drug before engaging in sexual activity and to use a stopwatch to record the time it took to achieve an erection. Men were able to get an erection as early as 16 minutes after taking the drug and could have a second sexual encounter up to 24 hours later. The only side effect reported was the occasional headache.

Cailis will soon be tested head-to-head against Viagra in upcoming studies.

Another exciting potency drug from Bayer has just completed its first large-scale patient trials. The drug vardenafil not only improved erections in up to 80 percent of men studied, but also increased their ability to complete sexual intercourse with ejaculation.

"Vardenafil improved erectile function in these men, regardless of their age, cause, or severity of their problem. This improvement occurred even at the lowest dose of 5 mg," said Dr. Irwin Goldstein of the Boston University School of Medicine. "There was another important finding as well," continued Goldstein. "In the overall study, vardenafil not only helped most men achieve erections, they also were able to sustain their erections and successfully complete intercourse."

The study involved 580 patients of ages 21-70. All had experienced difficulty achieving erections for an average of 2.8 years. The men were divided into four groups and received vardenafil in 5 mg, 10 mg, or 20 mg doses, or placebo on demand, but not more than once a day. Prior to treatment, the men were surveyed based on their ability to penetrate and on their ability to maintain an erection during intercourse. The scoring was based on a five-point scale, with one being the most difficulty penetrating and maintaining erections and five being the least difficulty.

The men who scored themselves at 1.0, having very little ability to penetrate, increased their score to a mean of 1.8 with placebo and to 3.0, 3.1, and 3.7 with 5 mg, 10 mg, and 20 mg of vardenafil, respectively. In other words, the increase in the ability to penetrate was much greater in the men treated than in the untreated men, although a higher dosage did not significantly improve the ability to penetrate over a lower dosage.

Men who scored themselves at 4.0 on their ability to penetrate prior to treatment, deteriorated to a mean score of 3.4 with placebo, but increased to a mean of 4.4, 4.7, or 4.4 for the same increasing doses of vardenafil.

The results for completion of intercourse were similar - the treated subjects improved regardless of severity. Those with a score of 1.0 (i.e., with very little ability to maintain an erection and complete intercourse) increased their score to a mean of 2.0 with placebo and to scores of 3.3, 3.1, and 3.5 with increasing doses of vardenafil. Those with a relatively mild degree of severity starting with a score of 4.0 had a decreased mean of 3.6 on placebo, but reached a score of 4.0, 4.3, or 4.7 with increasing doses of vardenafil.

There were very few side effects. The most frequent adverse events, whether related to the drug or not, were headache (7-15 percent), flushing (10-11 percent), rhinitis (3-7 percent), and dyspepsia (1-7 percent). The events were generally mild in intensity and related to dosage.

Vardenafil is now being evaluated in Phase III trials to better understand if these characteristics will translate into clinical benefits for patients. Results are expected for publication later this year, with completion of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) review in the second half of 2002.

Losartan

According to a study in this month\'s American Journal of the Medical Sciences, the drug losartan may be a hypertension drug also effective at treating sexual dysfunction.

After 12 weeks of treatment with the drug losartan, 88 percent of hypertensive males with sexual dysfunction reported improvement in at least one area of sexuality, said Carlos Ferrario, M.D., of Wake Forest University Baptist Medical Center (WFUBMC). The percentage of men reporting impotence dropped from 75.3 to 11.8.
"These results suggest a possible solution for people who\'ve stopped taking blood pressure medicines because they interfere with sexual function," said Ferrario. "In addition to controlling blood pressure as well or better than other medications, losartan seems to have a positive effect on sexuality."

The study used a self-administered questionnaire to screen 323 men and women with hypertension for sexual dysfunction, which includes decreased libido, impotence, and poor sexual satisfaction. Sexual dysfunction was diagnosed in 82 men, a prevalence of 42 percent. These 82 men were compared to an equal number of hypertensive men without sexual dysfunction. Both groups took 50 to 100 milligrams of losartan (sold under the brand name of Cozaar) daily for 12 weeks. They completed the questionnaire at both the beginning and end of the treatment period.

The increases in sexual function were dramatic.

In the men with sexual dysfunction, 88 percent reported improvement in at least one area of sexual function after treatment with losartan. The number reporting overall sexual satisfaction increased from 7.3 percent to 58.5 percent. The number reporting a high frequency (at least once a week) of sexual activity improved from 40.5 percent to 62.3 percent. An improved quality of life was reported by 73.7 percent of the men with sexual dysfunction.

Similar results were reported in a small group of women treated with losartan. The sample size, however, was too small for the results to be statistically validated.

In the group of men without sexual dysfunction, the drug treatment produced no changes in sexual function or satisfaction. This would indicate that unlike Viagra, IC351, and vardenafil, losartan would be of little benefit to those wishing to enhance already healthy sexual function, but could be a great alternative to some existing hypertension medications.

When scientists first started researching Tribulus terrestris, it was for the sole purpose of discovering a safe, natural treatment for sexual deficiencies.

Studies were conducted on 212 males, between 14 and 60 years old. The men studied suffered from partial or complete impotence. The studies methodology was a simple blind experiment, using a placebo. Tribulus of 42% concentration was individually administered to all patients who had not received hormonal agents for at least one month prior to the treatment.

Tribulus increases libido

Tribulus significantly raises natural testosterone production.

The effect of Tribulus has been studied on the serum concentration of the hormones: ACTH, STH, LH, FSH, adrenal hormone, aldosterone, and cortisol and on the sex hormones - testosterone and estradiol. The experiments were carried out on 8 males and 8 females, 28 - 45 years of age. Tribulus was administered in a single dose of 250 mg, three times daily for 5 days. Serum samples were drawn at 8 a.m. and 12 a.m., both before and after treatment.

It was established that Tribulus did not change the concentrations of adrenal hormones and of ACTH. However, the hypophyseal-gonadal axis was significantly changed. In females, there was a prominent increase in the concentration of FSH and estradiol. In the males there was a prominent increase in LH and testosterone. The mechanism of that action was presumed to be both by direct effect on the gonads and by the increase in certain hormones.

4. Mass Quantities Milk Protein Isolate
