1. What is a meal replacement?

Successful bodybuilders understand the importance of quality nutrition to their training regimen. Nutritious food, which is dense with protein, carbohydrates, and unsaturated fats, provide the fuel necessary to repair and build healthy muscles after breakdown from heavy weight training. The bodybuilder also knows that this food should be separated into six to seven separate meals that are spaced throughout the day. These small meals are more likely to be used as fuel than to be stored as fat for later use.

Unfortunately, most of us do not usually have the time set aside to prepare these seven meals each day. So we must recruit the help of a quality meal replacement to provide the calories necessary to facilitate muscle growth. A meal replacement shake is designed to be just that; a quick, convenient, and nutritious replacement to a meal that you do not have time to prepare. Unfortunately, the whole food meals that we tend to eat have high amounts of carbs and fats and low amounts of protein. An ideal meal replacement should contain between 300 - 400 calories with low fat, moderate carbohydrates, and high protein. Enter Mass Quantities TRIPLE THREAT 3/60. Mass Quantities has taken all the of the hard work out of preparing a muscle building meal in your kitchen by replacing it with a nutritious 350 calorie meal in a glass. These calories are combined in the perfect ratio for muscle building success.

TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 contains:

  • A whopping 60 grams of protein per serving.
  • 23 grams of carbohydrates.
  • 350 calories with only 2 grams of fat and less than 1 gram of sugar.
  • A Hoffman-LaRoche vitamin and mineral premix providing 100% US RDA of 16 vitamins and minerals.
  • The lowest sodium content of any meal replacement powder on the market.
  • Easily digestible.
  • Low lactose content.
  • Specially formulated to slow digestion, resulting in more protein absorption by the body.
  • Dramatically increases protein synthesis.
  • Increased muscle recovery and repair.
  • Decreased muscle breakdown.
  • Complete makeup of all Branch Chain Amino Acids (BCAA\'s).
  • 3 Protein blend contains all 20 essential and non essential amino acids.
  • Two great tasting flavors, Chocolate Milk Shake and Vanilla Milk Shake.
  • Instantized meaning it dissolves without a blender.

One big advantage to TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 is it\'s low sodium and high potassium concentrations. Our MRP contains only 108 mg of sodium, this is superior to Met-Rx\'s 370 mg and Myoplex\'s 330 mg of sodium per serving. TRIPLE THREAT 3/60\'s low sodium and high 696 mg of potassium per serving aid the body by decreasing water retention and cramping, and increasing muscle pumps. TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 has over 3.5 grams of glutamine per serving. This glutamine concentration will speed your muscle cell recovery to further aid your gains. TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 also contains a Hoffman-LaRoche vitamin and mineral premix which provides 100% of the recommended daily allowance of 16 vitamins and minerals. These nutritional factors make this MRP the most nutritious and best meal replacement powder on the market today.

TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 is instantized or agglomerated. This is a fancy word to mean that the protein molecules are of different sizes so that they fold right into solution with little stirring for maximum absorption.

The combination of whey, egg, and milk isolates provide a total protein that is very well balanced in overall amino acids. I combined these three whole-food protein sources so that synthetic amino acids would not be necessary as they are with single source protein products. What one protein source lacks in amino acid structure or content, the other two make up for with their own stronger amino acid structure or content. Let\'s take a look at these three powerful proteins individually.

2. Mass Quantities Whey Protein Isolate

Did you ever wonder what was that clear sweet liquid that separates from your cottage cheese, yogurt, or sour cream when you leave it in the fridge too long? That liquid is whey. For years, whey was considered a waste product of these dairy foods. Finally, someone got the bright idea to check out the make up of this milk waste product. What they found was that whey was extremely high in protein but had undesirable amounts of lactose, cholesterol, and fat. The whey protein was then separated from these undesirables using a technique known as micro-filtration and what is left is whey protein isolate.

In creating TRIPLE THREAT 3/60, I used the highest grade of whey protein available. The whey protein is micro-filtrated and Ion Exchanged. Micro- filtration is the method that is used to physically separate the proteins using a microscopic filter. Ion Exchange is the method used to extract and isolate the proteins by using their own specific electrical charge. This extraction method protects the protein molecule to assure that you are receiving the purest whey protein available. Here are the key benefits of our whey isolate.

1. The highest concentration of branch chain amino acids (BCAA\'s) among any single protein source.
2. Excellent amino acid profile, digestibility, and biological value.
3. Stimulates the body\'s IGF-1 production, the most potent anabolic hormone in the body.
4. Helps support the body\'s immune system functions.
5. Enhances your body\'s production of glutathione, the body\'s most powerful antioxidant.
6. Contains quadrapeptides that have shown pain killing properties, i.e. less muscle soreness after a workout.

As I mentioned above, whey protein contains the highest concentration of branch chain amino acids (BCAA\'s) of any single protein source. BCAA\'s are important to the bodybuilder because they are crucial to muscle metabolism. BCAA\'s are the first aminos sacrificed for fuel during muscle catabolism. Whey protein has the ability to stimulate the body\'s production of the anabolic hormone Insulin Growth Factor-1(IGF-1), the most anabolic hormone in the human body. Increased IGF-1 production translates into growth of new muscle cells and a greatly increased protein synthesis. Another functional property of whey protein is its ability to support immune system functions. Whey enhances your body\'s production of glutathione, the supreme naturally occurring antioxidant in the human body.

3. Mass Quantities Egg Albumin (White) Protein

For decades, egg white protein was considered the standard by which all other proteins would be measured. Egg whites (Albumin) have been considered a perfect source of protein because its natural amino acid pattern nearly matches what is needed for muscle and tissue growth in humans. Egg whites strong amino acid profile contains all the essential amino acids in the perfect efficiency ratio. Here is where egg protein excels:

1. Outstanding amino acid profile.
2. Amino acid profile matches what is needed for muscle and tissue growth in the body.
3. Most biologically available form of whole food protein.
4. Highly digestible.
5. Perfect score on the Protein Digestibility Corrected Amino Acid Score, complete for use in the human body.

This makes the egg white the protein of choice among all other whole food proteins. As a whole food, egg white protein is the most biologically available form of protein, scoring higher than the almighty chicken breast, skim milk and beef. Egg white is also one of the most digestible proteins available. Egg whites, along with milk protein, came back with a perfect score on the Protein Digestibility Corrected Amino Acid Score (PDCAAS). This high rating means that both egg and milk proteins are complete for use by the human body.

4. Mass Quantities Milk Protein Isolate

Milk protein is an excellent whole food for protein digestibility and overall amino acid profile. As a whole food however, milk contains loads of sugar. Skim milk contains 12 grams of sugar per 21 grams of weight. For every 8 grams of protein a bodybuilder gets from drinking a glass of milk, he is also getting 12 grams of sugar. That means carbohydrates make up 57% of milk\'s weight. This makes skim milk too high in carbohydrates to be used as an every day protein supplement. When the milk protein is isolated from skim milk, this carbohydrate percentage is reduced from 57% to an acceptable 8% per serving. This makes milk protein isolate a far better muscle-building supplement than plain old skim milk. Milk protein\'s key benefits:

1. Excellent amino acid profile.
2. High concentration of aminos threonine and arginine, increases growth hormone release, tissue healing, and increases glucose production and deters muscle breakdown.
3. Easily digestible and good taste.
4. Slows down digestion, more protein is absorbed by the body.
5. Low lactose content.

Milk isolate has a high concentration of the amino acids arginine and threonine. Arginine plays an essential role in nitrogen balance, tissue healing, and stimulating the immune system. Used in treatment of (hepatic) liver disorders. Threonine is the building block of all proteins. It stimulates the release of growth hormones that cause muscle growth while reducing body fat. Threonine also elevates moods and is used in the treatment of anxiety, depression, and insomnia. And, it aids in blood pressure regulation. These two amino acids work together to increase glucose production that will help deter muscle breakdown.

Milk isolate increases the overall effectiveness of TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 by aiding in digestion. Milk protein has the ability to slow down the digestion rate of the protein mixture by slowing the transit time of the mixture through the digestive tract. This process allows more of the protein supplement to be absorbed by the body. An increase in protein absorption means that more protein will be available to support muscle growth. We all know how hard it is to eat all the food necessary to build muscle, so any digestion aid is a plus.

One final benefit of Milk Protein is the taste. When combined with natural cocoa or vanilla, the use of milk protein gives our MRP a "Milk Shake" like taste. This is because milk protein has a very good "mouth-feel" that makes our MRP smooth and creamy.

5. Continuous Protein Feeding

As a hard training bodybuilder, your body needs protein every 2 to 2 1/2 hours even if you think you may not need it. The human body does not store protein long term like it does for fat and carbohydrates. Instead, your body holds amino acids in three pools that provide the body\'s necessary protein for fuel. These pools are constantly in a state of flux and are replenished either from dietary protein or the breakdown of muscle. It is extremely important to keep these amino acid pools topped off through consistent protein feedings. When feeding stops, there is a fall in protein synthesis and a rise in protein breakdown. This translates into a loss of lean body mass after extended periods without protein. When following a weight training regimen, your body needs between 1 to 1 1/2 grams of protein per pound of body weight in order to provide the building blocks for muscle growth.

Protein increases your body\'s metabolism. Your metabolism will rise every time you eat a meal. Digestion, absorption, and storage of food cause this metabolic change. When you consume a high protein meal, your body\'s metabolism will rise five times higher than it does after you eat a high carb meal. Protein helps control your body\'s water balance. Protein works with certain minerals to regulate how much water should be in the body. If you are not consuming enough protein in your diet, you will retain water.

After a hard weight-training session, you\'ll want the raw material (protein!) that repairs worked-out muscle tissue ... something that\'s delicious and smooth, easy to gulp down and digest ... something that\'s more like a treat than a chore. And that\'s where TRIPLE THREAT 3/60 will come in. Because few would argue that the right time for a quick high- protein, moderate-carbohydrate meal is right after exhaustive resistance training.

In other words, while it\'s true that you may benefit from varying your protein intake, it\'s NOT true that when you DO eat protein that you can only eat a small serving of it. So when you want protein - when you NEED it - don\'t be afraid to go for the gusto and chug down a nice, big portion. It\'s good for you!

6. Developing Triple Threat 3/60

Mass Quantities has always brought you the highest-grade steroid pre-cursor supplements on the market. So although I have been associated with Mass Quantities for years now, I was honored when they asked me to design their new Meal Replacement Powder or MRP. It really does taste great - this was the goal - I know how I get tired of other MRP\'s after a while. I did not put any other "trick" ingredients in the mix, since I wanted my MRP to taste great and be a whole food not a dietary supplement. The protein blend provides optimal Amino Acid profiles and really improves the "mouth feel."

EliteFitness.com – Underground Bodybuilding, Fitness and Steroid Site – Tons of Bodybuilding, Weight Lifting, and Anabolic Steroids

May 9, 2014 by George Spellwin

As you know, many powerful forces would like to shut down the EliteFitness.com website. Most of them are enemies of hardcore bodybuilding. But once in a while, some of the most vicious attacks come from within the bodybuilding community itself. Last week, Paul Gardiner, President of MuscleTech, and his lawyers came after the EliteFitness.com site, our members, and me with a vengeance.

On January 26, I received a letter from MuscleTech\'s lawyers at the powerful New York law firm, Kenyon and Kenyon. The letter alleges that by allowing you to post your comments about the MuscleTech brand of nutritional supplements on our discussion boards, EliteFitness.com is guilty of "false advertising ... unfair competition, product disparagement, trade libel, and interference with prospective economic advantage." They also accuse us of infringing their trademarks and copyrights.

More scary still, not only is MuscleTech demanding that we censor your free speech; they also want us to reveal to them the names of our members who have made discussion board posts on EliteFitness.com about their company. In other words, MuscleTech and their high priced lawyers demand that we violate our own privacy policy and provide them with personal information about, our members - something we would absolutely NEVER do. They further threaten that if we do not provide them with your personal information, they will sue both the EliteFitness.com site and me personally.

On Monday, I attempted to telephone Paul Gardiner at MuscleTech to discuss the letter. I always believe its productive to discuss differences of opinion and try and reach common ground. Unfortunately, Paul Gardiner refused to take my telephone call and instructed me to put any response to him in writing. My letter to MuscleTech follows their letter to me.

Please click here to read the first MuscleTech thread and here to read the second MuscleTech thread.

Here\'s my response to the MuscleTech letter:


The Most Controversial Fitness Site On The Net!

From the desk of
George Spellwin
[email protected]
888-613-9136

Mr. Paul Gardiner
MuscleTech Research and Development, Inc.
7050 Telford Way, Suite 100
Mississauga, ON
L5S 1V7

January 31, 2002

Dear Mr. Gardiner,

This letter is in response to your attorney\'s letter of January 24, 2002.

Since 1996, elitefitness.com has provided discussion boards for the frank and honest discussion of fitness in general and the sport of bodybuilding in particular. Our own members moderate our boards, but the forums are uncensored. We remove posts that are hateful of any particular group of members, but that is largely all that is removed. Our goal is to stimulate conversation, not to stifle it.

Regarding your letter\'s allegations of our treatment of your company and products, EliteFitness.com has never advertised falsely, competed unfairly, did not disparage your products, nor have we interfered with your prospective economic advantage. In fact, not only have we never written about MuscleTech, but also I myself have never used a MuscleTech product. In fact, I was not even aware of the message threads that you are threatening to sue me over until your attorney brought them to my attention.

In the letter of January 24, your attorney informed me that MuscleTech enjoys an enormous amount of goodwill as well as a fine reputation. I have no basis upon which to disagree; however, your reluctance to make a simple post on the elitefitness.com site to clarify any possible misperceptions combined with your threats and drastic litigious response would seem to suggest otherwise.

When our members are critical of a company\'s products and practices, mine included, often, the company\'s principles will come participate on our discussion boards in order to better educate our members. Indeed, Patrick Arnold from ErgoPharm, Bill Llewellyn from Molecular Nutrition, and the late Dan Duchaine from Next Nutrition have all participated from time to time on our site and are all highly respected.

Regarding the demands in your letter, EliteFitness.com has never made any remarks about MuscleTech\'s products and we have no plans to make any at this time. The "real time" nature of our boards makes them impossible to censor, and indeed we would never censor our members speech even if we were able to. In fact, elitefitness.com is a place where our members can and do post critical comments about both the EliteFitness.com website and me. We do not remove or edit those comments, but instead we try to communicate our point of view.

As an example, when we launched our Platinum discussion board memberships, many of our members were outraged that we had to begin charging for services that had previously been free. But once they learned that the Platinum members were responsible for keeping our site online and enabling us to afford legal challenges like this one, they largely changed their mind. I would sincerely encourage you to come to elitefitness.com and to help educate us on your point of view and to tell us more about the "substantial time and money" devoted to "research and development." I\'m certain that your time is very valuable, but surely, this would be a better use of your time and money than to attack a web site for allowing the free exchange of ideas.

Lastly, of everything in your letter, I am extremely concerned that a company which you have informed me enjoys such a fine reputation would ask us to violate the terms of our privacy policy and reveal to them the personal details of our members. I have reviewed your own privacy policy, and I notice that you, like EliteFitness.com, claim not to license, sell, or give away your member\'s personal information to any third parties. Your asking us to violate our own privacy policy and provide you with personal information about our members makes me suspicious that this may not in fact be the case. Indeed Mr. Gardiner, I would shut down the entire EliteFitness.com site before I gave out the personal information about even one of our members to you or to anyone else.

I sincerely hope that you will end this foolishness about a lawsuit and put that money instead into more of the research and development you informed me that you do so much of. And I know I can better spend my money improving the elitefitness.com site, than giving it to lawyers. If you do change your mind and decide that you would like to talk with me, you may call me at any time. Or preferably, if there are some misperceptions about your organization that you wish to correct, I hope to see you on our discussion boards making your perspective known. I am certain that education will be much less costly and much more effective than mounting a legal attack on our site, our members, and on me.

As some of our longtime subscribers may remember, back in 1997, Mass Quantities literally revolutionized diet supplementation when we took the classic ECA (ephedrine, caffeine, aspirin) stack and substituted 1R,2S Norephedrine HCl for basic Ephedrine. We then added Yohimbine HCl, another pharmaceutical, and the ultimate diet pill was born. For the first time, a diet drug stack was created that combined Norephedrine and Yohimbine HCl. The diet drug combo was revolutionary because it was the first time a company had marketed a diet pill with the muscle sparing and fat burning properties of Norephedrine stacked with Yohimbine HCl\'s localize fat mobilization properties.

We called our first-generation diet formulation Adipokinetix, and after improving the different drug ratios, adding aspirin, and changing from capsules to tablets, Phenyltropic PPA was born. The name Phenyltropic PPA came from the Norephedrine component, which also goes by the name Phenylpropanolamine or just PPA for short.

Dieters worldwide praised this product as the most effective diet pill they had ever used. But unfortunately, it was too effective, and the entire class of medications containing PPA came under the watchful eye of our friends at the FDA.

Although the FDA has not banned PPA outright, they made it so difficult to obtain, that all manufacturers were forced to switch over to herbal diet tablets. But although an excellent choice for the dieter, it is not quite the same as its 100% drug-based cousin Phenyltropic PPA.

Well as luck would have it, Mass Quantities was able to secure a VERY limited supply of pharmaceutical Phenylpropanolamine and pharmaceutical Yohimbine HCl and so Phenyltropic PPA is once again available -- although in very small amounts. Click here to get it while you still can!

Now before I explain what makes 100% drug-based Phenyltropic PPA so special, I should tell you about the restrictions on its sale.

  1. Phenyltropic PPA may not be purchased by anyone under the age of 18.
  2. Phenyltropic PPA cannot be sold to residents of the State of Arizona in any quantity.
  3. California residents may not buy more than three bottles of Phenyltropic PPA.
  4. International customers are strongly encouraged to check with the authorities in their respective locations regarding the legality of Phenyltropic PPA inside their countries. Phenyltropic PPA is not available in Germany, the Netherlands, and Australia.
  5. Phenyltropic PPA cannot be used by women who are pregnant or nursing.
  6. Anyone considering Phenyltropic PPA should get a doctor\'s blessing before using this product.

As I have preached in EF News for years, when you buy herbal supplements, you want to look for "standardized extracts" like the standardized herbals found in regular Phenyltropic. Standardization means that the raw materials have been analyzed to ensure that you are getting a consistent amount of the active ingredient. But when you see HCl, you know you are getting a drug and not a supplement and Phenyltropic PPA, containing 25mg of 1R, 2S Norephedrine HCl, 3.75mg of Yohimbine HCl, 40mg of aspirin, and 90mg of caffeine, is entirely drug based.

Now, I don\'t mean to scare you, Phenyltropic PPA is drug based, but if you use it as directed, Phenyltropic PPA is both safe and highly effective. PPA itself, is an ingredient in hundreds of medications including Alka-Seltzer, Comtrex, Dimetapp, Robitussin, and Tavist-D. PPA is effective in relieving nasal congestion and it is popular in diet pills because it suppresses the appetite.

So why then did the FDA work so hard to keep PPA from manufacturers?

Well, there are the official reasons, and then there are the suspicions of those companies that sold PPA. Officially, a Yale study found a very small increase in the risk of stroke among women taking PPA and an even smaller risk among men. How small an increased risk? Minuscule. In fact, six billion PPA doses are sold every year in the United States. That\'s the official reason, but I suspect the real reason is really two fold. PPA is highly effective for muscle-sparing fat loss and is also effective as a cough and cold medication. But PPA is inexpensive compared to other newer diet and cold pharmaceuticals that require a doctor\'s prescription. I suspect that the big drug companies pushed for the ban because they do not make any money from an effective over-the-counter weight loss products and cough and cold medication.

My other suspicion is that the FDA was encouraged by the DEA to get Phenylpropanolamine off the market, because when synthesized, it can be used to make crystal methamphetamine -- also known as speed. Rest assured, PPA does give you an energy boost, but it is not speed. In fact, many dieters prefer PPA to ephedrine, because although close cousins, PPA provides a more consistent, sustained energy and longer fat burning effect than ephedrine whose "buzz" is too much for some users.

So how does Phenyltropic PPA work to increase energy and promote fat loss?

A study appearing in the International Journal Of Obesity described the effects of a caffeine/ephedrine stack on 99 patients who had taken the drug combination for 50 weeks. The dosage used was 20 mg of ephedrine and 200 mg of caffeine three times a day. A dramatic reduction in body fat took place during the initial 24 weeks of the study. Although the body fat reduction was not as pronounced during the second 24-week period, fat reduction still took place. Fortunately, lean body mass was preserved. No withdrawal symptoms occurred upon cessation of the use of these two drugs and no serious side effects were observed.

PPA (Norephedrine) and caffeine work synergistically to drastically increase the body\'s production of the hormones adrenaline and noradrenaline. These hormones bind to the various receptors in the body, of which we are mainly interested in the A2, B2, and B3 receptors. These receptors play an important role in fat loss and fat mobilization.

Now this is a little complicated, but read through this and you will realize why it is so important to understand. The B2 and the B3 receptors are responsible for the mobilization and burning of adipose (fat) tissue. These are the receptors that we want to stimulate because these receptors influence fat loss in a positive way. By stimulating these receptors with caffeine and PPA, we increase the metabolism of fat and we slightly elevate the body\'s temperature. This elevation in the body\'s temperature is called thermogenesis.

Thermogenesis is a fancy way of saying raised body temperature. Thermogenesis is a good thing for the dieter, because it promotes fat loss. Unfortunately, it is hard to achieve a prolonged state of thermogenesis and this explains why fat loss that was significant at first decreases over time.

Try taking your body\'s temperature first thing upon waking in the morning. While dieting, if your waking temperature is between 97.8 and 98.2 degrees Fahrenheit, you are in a fat burning mode. A few individuals with optimal metabolism will have a body temperature of higher than 98.2, but eventually all dieters will get below the optimal range and will find that fat burning becomes much more difficult. On almost any diet, body temperature decreases over time.

Here\'s a summary of what is actually happening when you diet with PPA and caffeine.

  1. Initially, the B2 and B3 receptors are stimulated causing an increased production of adrenaline and noradrenaline.
  2. This increased production raises the body\'s temperature.
  3. Lots of fat is lost in the cells that are high in B1 receptors.
  4. However, very little fat is lost in the cells that have many A2 receptors. The A2 receptors are concentrated in the abs and love handles in men and on the hips and thighs in women.
  5. As dieting continues, noradrenaline levels drop and the body\'s temperature begins to fall along with it.
  6. As temperature drops over time, fat loss slows.
  7. In the remaining fat cells, the number of A2 receptors increases, compared to B2 and B3 receptors, and the body will chose to burn amino acids from muscle tissue for fuel instead of fat.

So, the best way to prevent the slow down in fat loss would be to block the A2 receptors from accepting noradrenaline.

Research has shown that the A2 receptor blocks the mobilization of adipose (fat) tissue -- so in terms of fat-loss, this receptor is the bad guy. This receptor gives women a hard time losing fat -- especially in their lower body - no matter how hard they diet. And in men, the concentration of this receptor in the abdominal region and around the love handles gives guys a hard time burning fat around the waist - no matter how hard they diet.

In order to block the ugly A2 receptor, Mass Quantities pioneered the use of Yohimbine HCl in conjunction with Mass Quantities\' PPA modified version of the ECA stack. Yohimbine HCl is an effective way to block A2 receptors because it is an A2 antagonist or blocker. An A2 antagonist will allow for increased lipolysis or fat break down in the problem areas and it potentiates or make stronger the fat burning effects of both caffeine and ephedrine. Basically, Yohimbine cripples your body\'s negative feedback loop and breaks the cycles of generalized fat loss that makes it more difficult to lose fat in the stubborn areas. In a nutshell, the Yohimbine HCl in Phenyltropic PPA allows you to break the rules of dieting - and get away with it.

As an added bonus, Yohimbine is a proven aphrodisiac and can promote erections in men and increased libido in women. In fact, in America, it is sold by prescription as a potency treatment drug.

Author: George Spellwin

Filed Under: Uncategorized

EliteFitness.com – Underground Bodybuilding, Fitness and Steroid Site – Tons of Bodybuilding, Weight Lifting, and Anabolic Steroids

May 9, 2014 by George Spellwin

GHB is Gamma hydroxybutyrate. GHB has been around for years, but in 1999, it took Rohypnol\'s place when it became known as the date rape drug. Bodybuilders have long been interested in GHB for promoting restorative sleep and for its possible growth hormone (GH) release connection. In the last year a great deal of new research has been done on GHB that indicates that at controlled dosages, its side effects are practically non-existent and that there is a definitely a connection between GHB and GH release.

In this issue of Elite Fitness News, we\'ll look at the new research on GHB. We\'ll also look at how bodybuilders are using it to aid in muscle development and improve recovery times. We\'ll also take a look at some of the latest research that indicates that many of the side effects attributed to GHB by the media were largely unfounded.

In May of 1999, our friends at the FDA recommended that GHB become a Schedule I Controlled Substance. In September of that year, the House of Representatives voted 423 to 1, and the Senate voted unanimously in favor of the FDA\'s recommendations. And by November, the Drug Enforcement Agency was treating GHB just like heroin and other Schedule I drugs. In early 2000, President Clinton signed the legislation.

However, an important exception was made in the legislation. President Clinton said in a White House statement: "The Act will not impede ongoing research into the potential legitimate use of this drug to treat the special needs of those suffering from narcolepsy. Indeed, this Act creates a special exemption that provides that the manufacture and distribution of this drug for properly approved research purposes will be subject to the physical security requirements of Schedule III rather than Schedule I."

Although GHB is very easily and cheaply manufactured, for better or worse, the FDA gave the drug companies permission to study GHB for possible sale as a pharmaceutical. In essence, what had happened is that GHB went from being an inexpensive and effective sleep aid that had been available as an OTC or as a gray market supplement and re-regulated it for the benefit of the drug companies.

Around this time, Orphan Medical, a drug company in Minneapolis, began research into using GHB for the treatment of narcolepsy. They developed a medically formulated GHB product and given it the brand name Xyrem. Although certainly motivated by profit, Orphan Medical has conducted several studies that indicate that GHB or Xyrem should not be a demonized Schedule I drug. Their research further indicates that GHB is relatively safe and can be an effective treatment for sleep disorders.

All of Orphan\'s studies have involved the use of GHB to treat narcoleptics. Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological disorder affecting an estimated 100,000 to 125,000 Americans. The main symptoms are excessive daytime sleepiness and cataplexy. Cataplexy is a debilitating symptom characterized by loss of muscle control in response to strong emotions such as laughter, anger, or surprise. In its most severe form, cataplexy can cause a person to collapse during waking hours.

Of primary interest to us as bodybuilders is how a narcoleptic\'s sleep patterns differ from the sleep patterns of a normal person. When you and I sleep, our sleep is divided into 5 stages. Stages 1 through 4 are the non-REM stages. Stage 5 is the REM stage. REM stands for Rapid Eye Movement. REM sleep is distinguishable from Non-REM sleep by changes in physiological states, where heart rate increases, respiration speeds up and becomes erratic, and the face, fingers, and legs may twitch. Intense dreaming occurs during REM sleep as a result of heightened cerebral activity, but paralysis occurs simultaneously in the major voluntary muscle groups. Here\'s what happens in a healthy sleep cycle.

The Non-REM Stages

Stage 1
Stage 1 sleep is essentially drowsiness. Polysomnography shows a 50% reduction in activity between wakefulness and stage 1 sleep. The eyes are closed during stage 1 sleep, but if aroused from it, you feel like you have not slept. Stage 1 lasts for about 10 minutes.

Stage 2
Stage 2 is a period of light sleep during which polysomnographic readings show intermittent peaks and valleys, or positive and negative waves. These waves indicate spontaneous periods of muscle tone mixed with periods of muscle relaxation. The heart rate slows, and body temperature decreases. At this point, the body prepares to enter deep sleep.

Stages 3 and 4
These are deep sleep stages and the ones we are primarily concerned with as bodybuilders. Stage 4 is more intense than stage 3. These stages are known as slow-wave, or delta-sleep. During slow-wave sleep, especially during stage 4, the electromyogram records slow waves of high amplitude, indicating a pattern of deep sleep.

Studies have tracked the levels of certain hormones during the sleep cycle -- in particular, the release of growth hormone (GH). In men, but not in women, 60 to 70 percent of the body\'s GH is secreted during the slow-wave stage of sleep. Interestingly, studies have shown that, infants and adolescents have higher levels of GH and also spend much more time in stages 3 and 4 sleep. Obviously, both infants and adolescents are in a state of rapid growth. Other research has shown that as men move from early adulthood (16 to 25 years) into middle age (36 to 50 years), the time spent in slow wave sleep decreases by about 15 percent. This corresponds to a drop in GH production and possibly to what we commonly call "middle-aged spread."

Non-REM Sleep
The period of non-REM sleep is comprised of stages 1-4 and lasts from 90 to 120 minutes, each stage lasting anywhere from 5 to 15 minutes. Surprisingly, however, Stages 2 and 3 repeat backwards before REM sleep is attained. So, a normal sleep cycle has this pattern: waking, stage 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, REM. Usually, REM sleep occurs 90 minutes after sleep onset.

After analyzing their findings, the researchers suggested that it might be possible to "treat" the aging process in men by adjusting their sleep patterns. Also, medications that enhance the slow wave phase of sleep could possibly help compensate for medically low GH levels in younger people. More research is needed to determine if this is a practical solution. However the study supports the idea that sleep patterns can be related to metabolism as well.

The five stages of sleep, including their repetition, occur cyclically. The first cycle, which ends after the completion of the first REM stage, usually lasts for 100 minutes. Each subsequent cycle lasts longer, as its respective REM stage extends. So a person may complete five cycles in a typical night\'s sleep.

A narcolepsy patient typically enters into REM sleep soon after falling asleep. This abnormal phenomenon is part of the diagnostic profile of narcolepsy. As such, the narcoleptic is largely deprived of the benefits of stage 3 and 4 sleep and the associated GH release. So, Orphan Medical began several studies where GHB or Xyrem, as they call it, was administered to narcoleptics. The results were very promising both for narcolepsy patients, aging men, and for bodybuilders.

What is 4-Androstenediol?

Mass Quantities Andro Infusion contains 100mgs of 4-Androstenediol (abbreviated as 4-AD) in each capsule. 4-AD is the most anabolic of all the steroid precursors in the Andro family and is a direct metabolite and precursor to the anabolic hormone testosterone. 4-AD uses the enzyme 3 beta-HSD (3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase) to convert directly to the anabolic hormone testosterone in the human body. This 3 beta-HSD conversion is more efficient than any other steroid precursor compound. The end result is a compound that provides higher levels of testosterone conversion than any other steroid precursor on the market.

A study performed at Michigan State University tested the conversion rates of the testosterone steroid precursors Androstenedione against the 4-Androstenediol in Mass Quantities Andro Infusion. This study found that 4-AD provided a 310% higher increase in total testosterone over Androstendione, and a 256% higher increase in free testosterone.

Another of the most favorable benefits of the 4-AD in Andro Infusion is that it does not convert to estrogen. As you may know, testosterone and some steroid precursors, in high dosages, can cause aromatization. This is the biological process that causes testosterone hormones to be converted to undesirable estrogen hormones. But fortunately, with 4-AD aromatization is not an issue. 4-AD lacks the chemical structure to aromatize into estrogen. To keep the biological process simple, we will say that for a substance to aromatize it needs a specific ketone group to be available during the conversion process. Testosterone and Androstenedione both have this ketone group and can convert to estrogen whereas 4-AD does not contain this group and therefore cannot be converted to estrogen.

The extreme anabolic properties of 4-AD along with its extremely low side effect profile has led experts such as supplement guru Bio-chemist Patrick Arnold to call 4-Androstenediol the king of all steroid precursors.

What is 5-Androstenediol?

Mass Quantities Andro Infusion contains 50mgs of 5-Androstenediol (abbreviated as 5-AD) in each capsule. 5-AD is sold in pharmacies in Germany under the trade name Stenadiol and throughout Europe under the name Methandrol as an anabolic steroid. Considered by many European countries to be too strong for sale as a nutritional supplement, the laws in the US differ from those across the Atlantic. Since 5-AD is technically speaking a steroid precursor, it falls into the same category as Androstenedione and Norandrostenedione and for now is completely legal to sell and possess in the U.S.

Although 5-AD does not provide as great a testosterone conversion as 4-AD, 5-AD has proven to be extremely anabolic in it\'s unconverted form. This means that 5-AD does not seem to require testosterone conversion to build muscle. This unique property makes it is far less androgenic than androstenedione which in turn makes it far less likely to cause unwanted side effects.

Lastly, 5-AD has been shown to suppress Cortisol levels in the body. Cortisol is the catabolic hormone that is released during heavy lifting and can cause muscle deterioration and can prevent muscle growth. 5-AD has also shown the ability to boost ones immune system by increasing your body\'s resistance to infections. Some bodybuilders have taken this product along with anabolic steroids or steroid precursors to boost their immune systems lowered by anabolics.

Why combine 4-AD and 5-AD?

The most important muscle building benefit of 5-AD is its ability to make other anabolic steroids or steroid precursors more effective. Just as Methandriol is added to other Anabolic steroids to make them more effective, Mass Quantities has added 5-AD (the unesterfied version of Methandriol) to the 4-AD in Andro Infusion to make it more effective as well. You see, 5-AD directly effects bound testosterone to free it up and make it more bio-available. By combining 5-AD with 4-AD, we create the optimal anabolic steroid precursor combination because of 4-AD\'s increased effectiveness.

Besides the synergistic effect of freeing up more testosterone and making 4-AD more effective, why else do we combine 5-AD and 4-AD? These two steroid precursors make the optimal stack, as they both use the same enzyme (3-Beta Hydrosteroid) to convert to the anabolic steroid testosterone. And, when they are taken together, their combination causes more of this crucial enzyme to become available. This increased availability and improved conversion makes the compounds more anabolic than when either is taken alone.

Maximum Enzyme Delivery System

Using the same breakthrough technology that we developed for our Norabol product, Mass Quantities reengineered Andro Infusion also contains the MED System. The MED System is scientifically designed to enhance and protect crucial enzyme functions guaranteeing maximum enzyme conversions and productivity.

Unlike Andro Infusion\'s injectable anabolic steroid counterparts, oral steroid precursors like 4-AD and 5-AD are subject to "first pass." For any steroid precursor to work, it must be absorbed by the stomach and intestines and then metabolized by the liver into the active anabolic hormone. Mass Quantities exclusive Maximum Enzyme Delivery System or MED system is made up of precise ratios of zinc, niacin, and silymarin and takes steroid precursor supplementation, as you once knew it, to a whole new level.

In the body, the enzyme 3 beta-HSD (3-Beta Hydrosteroid) is directly responsible for the conversion of the steroid precursors 4-AD and 5-AD into the muscle building anabolic steroid testosterone. By ensuring the proper levels and functionality of the 3 beta-HSD enzyme, research suggests that the conversion of the 4-AD and 5-AD in Andro Infusion into the testosterone steroid can be significantly improved. The fact that the Andro family converts to testosterone without conversion agents is testament enough to its incredible potency. So, by adding conversion agents like those in the MED System, we can increase the bio-availability of the 3 beta-HSD enzyme and therefore increase the amount of the anabolic steroid testosterone that will ultimately be available at the cellular level.

Zinc And Niacin

Zinc, the first ingredient in the Mass Quantities MED System, plays a critical role in liver enzyme function and synthesis. In fact, zinc is so important in the body that enzymes like 3 beta-HSD, become completely nonfunctional in its absence. The 3 beta-HSD enzyme is known as a metallo-enzyme, meaning it requires a metal, in this case zinc, to be tightly bound to its structure, for it to exert activity in the body. 3 beta-HSD is therefore considered a zinc dependent enzyme. The activity of the 3 beta-HSD enzyme is enhanced when sufficient levels of zinc are present in the body.

In addition to requiring zinc, 3 beta-HSD also requires sufficient niacin-based coenzymes for it to become biologically active. Supplemental niacin ensures that these coenzymes are available for 3 beta-HSD to bind with. Binding with the niacin-based coenzymes increases 3 beta-HSD\'s bio-availability and thereby improves 4-Ad\'s and 5-AD\'s conversion into testosterone.

The specific niacin based coenzymes required by the 3 beta-HSD enzyme are nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) or nicotinamide adenine dinucleotid phosphate (NADP). These coenzymes function as hydrogen carriers, and are necessary for all dehydrogenase enzyme reactions. A dehydrogenase enzyme reaction is one that accelerates the removal of hydrogen from metabolites and its transfer to other substances. Remember that 4-AD and 5-AD are only one hydrogen atom away from being the active steroid testosterone, so you can see the importance of the availability of these hydrogen carrier enzymes for a conversion to take place. Without these two coenzymes, no transfer of hydrogen atoms is possible, and the body is not able to convert steroid precursors to active steroids.

Silymarin

Silymarin, a standardized extract of the Silybum Marianum plant, is a key component of the MED System. Silymarin is highly recognized for its ability to improve overall liver function and promote new liver cell regeneration. By supporting liver cell regeneration and enzyme function steroid precursor conversion rates are optimized. Silymarin is also a powerful antioxidant and liver protectant making it the ideal addition to a steroid precursor stack.

The powerful medicinal actions of Silybum Marianum have been known for more than 2,000 years. The most noted use being to treat cases of cirrhosis, hepatitis, and Death Cap mushroom poisoning--where its effectiveness is nothing short of remarkable. More recently, steroid using athletes have caught on to the benefits of silymarin. Silymarin is often taken in conjunction with heavy oral steroid use to alleviate the extra stress to the liver. In many cases silymarin has been shown to prevent or even reverse steroid related damage. Although steroid precursors are not liver toxic like some oral anabolic steroids, we can help ensure maximum liver enzyme performance, and overall liver activity through the addition of this amazing extract\'s regenerative effects.

The fact that 19-norandrostenedione converts to nandrolone without conversion agents is testament enough to its incredible potency. So, by adding conversion agents like those in the MED System, we can increase the bio-availability of the 17BHSD enzyme and therefore increase the amount of the anabolic steroid nandrolone that will ultimately be available at the cellular level.

ZINC AND NIACIN Zinc, the first ingredient in the Mass Quantities MED System, plays a critical role in liver enzyme function and synthesis. In fact, zinc is so important in the body that enzymes like 17 beta-hydroxysteroid (17BHSD), become completely nonfunctional in its absence. The 17BHSD enzyme is known as a metallo-enzyme, meaning it requires a metal, in this case zinc, to be tightly bound to its structure, for it to exert activity in the body. 17BHSD is therefore considered a zinc dependent enzyme. The activity of the 17BHSD enzyme is enhanced when sufficient levels of zinc are present in the body.

In addition to requiring zinc, 17BHSD also requires sufficient niacin-based coenzymes for it to become biologically active. Supplemental niacin ensures that these coenzymes are available for 17BHSD to bind with. Binding with the niacin-based coenzymes increases 17BHSD\'s bio-availability and thereby improves 19-norandrostenedione conversion into nandrolone.

The specific niacin based coenzymes required by the 17BHSD enzyme are nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) or nicotinamide adenine dinucleotid phosphate (NADP). These coenzymes function as hydrogen carriers, and are necessary for all dehydrogenase enzyme reactions. A dehydrogenase enzyme reaction is one that accelerates the removal of hydrogen from metabolites and its transfer to other substances. Remember that 19-norandrostenedione is only one hydrogen atom away from being the active steroid nandrolone, so you can see the importance of the availability of these hydrogen carrier enzymes for a conversion to take place. Without these two coenzymes, no transfer of hydrogen atoms is possible, and the body is not able to convert steroid precursors to active steroids.

SILYMARIN Silymarin, a standardized extract of the Silybum Marianum plant, is a key component of the MED System. Silymarin is highly recognized for its ability to improve overall liver function and promote new liver cell regeneration. By supporting liver cell regeneration and enzyme function steroid precursor conversion rates are optimized. Silymarin is also a powerful antioxidant and liver protectant making it the ideal addition to a steroid precursor stack.

The powerful medicinal actions of Silybum Marianum have been known for more than 2,000 years. The most noted use being to treat cases of cirrhosis, hepatitis, and Death Cap mushroom poisoning -- where its effectiveness is nothing short of remarkable. More recently, steroid using athletes have caught on to the benefits of silymarin. Silymarin is often taken in conjunction with heavy oral steroid use to alleviate the extra stress to the liver. In many cases silymarin has been shown to prevent or even reverse steroid related damage. Although steroid precursors are not liver toxic like some oral anabolic steroids, we can help ensure maximum liver enzyme performance, and overall liver activity through the addition of this amazing extract\'s regenerative effects.

2. Norabol -- guaranteed to make you stronger, leaner, and remarkably more muscular or your money back. A refresher on how it works.

In the world of bodybuilding, the fact still remains that the fastest way to radically change your body composition is through the use of anabolic steroids. This is the undeniable secret behind the physiques of today\'s top models and bodybuilders. The trouble with steroids, like the ever-popular Deca Durabolin, is that you have to break the law to get them, and you can never be totally sure you got what you paid for.

My favorite legal alternative to anabolic steroids is the steroid precursor 19-norandrostendione. Mass Quantities new Norabol now contains 100mg/cap 19-norandrostenedione, the nandrolone steroid precursor, combined with Mass Quantities exclusive MED system. Each bottle contains 100 capsules, so now you get 1000mg more 19-nor per bottle absolutely FREE. As a precursor, or one step removed in the biosynthesis process, 19-norandrostenedione converts safely and naturally in the body to the highly anabolic and extremely effective nandrolone (Deca Durabolin).

As I am sure many of you have noticed, there has been an awful lot of hype and controversy surrounding the testosterone enhancing supplement androstenedione. Androstenedione has demonstrated its effectiveness at increasing muscularity, vascularity, endurance, and strength. Mass Quantities Norabol does all the above with the remarkable added benefit of improved lipolysis or increased fat mobilization giving you a leaner, harder look. Additionally, Norabol has far fewer potential side effects than its androstenedione cousin.

According to steroid guru Dan Duchaine, "19-nortestosterone is a testosterone molecule without a carbon molecule at the 19th position. So nor-Androstenedione (Norabol for short) is simply an androstenedione molecule without any carbon at the 19th position... The interesting thing about nor-Androstenedione is that the dehydrogenase enzyme in the liver won\'t add any carbon at the 19th position. It adds only a hydrogen at the 17th position. So, without any carbon added, the norandrostenedione won\'t be converted to testosterone. It\'s converted to nor-testosterone instead. In basic terms: nor-Androstenedione is converted to nandrolone in the liver."

The highly anabolic properties of nandrolone, and therefore Norabol, are undisputed. Going back to the days of Arnold Schwarzenegger and Franco Columbu, nandrolone has been a favorite of anyone out to maximize muscular gains while minimizing the risk of side effects. In fact, Deca-Durabolin -- a nandrolone-based steroid -- is the most popular anabolic steroid on the market today.

Nandrolone easily binds to the body\'s steroid receptors and remains attached even longer than testosterone giving you the most muscle and strength building power available. Nandrolones are preferable to testosterones because of their poor conversion to undesirable estrogenic compounds, and because the androgenic side effects like acne, increased body-hair growth, and acceleration of male pattern baldness are not nearly as prevalent. This low side effect profile makes Norabol the ideal for women and anyone else concerned about taking the more androgenic steroid precursors like androstenedione.
